words: That's a little better, but I also noticed that the leg seems to be very wavy. I think the top part makes sense because it's the thigh going to a knee. So there's a hinge there. So that makes sense how it curves backwards. But then in the middle of the shin, it looks like the shin itself is an arc. I feel like that needs to be reworked a little bit so that the shin looks more reasonable
direction: Retain the improved fullness and thigh-to-knee articulation, but remove the bowed shin. Use a straight underlying knee-to-ankle segment with soft muscle contour and localized joint transitions.
scope: Art construction refinement; no skeletal canon or locomotion ability change
